product_metadata.title: Primula 14 Ounce Coffee Mug, Vacuum Insulated Stainless Steel Mug with Leak Proof Lid, Double Wall Travel Tumbler Cup Thermos, Keep Drinks Hot or Cold, White
features: STAYS HOT OR COLD FOR HOURS: This double-wall vacuum sealed insulated mug can keep drinks hot for up to 3 hours or cold for up to 8 hours.
PERFECT FOR COFFEE, TEA, AND MORE: Keep coffee, tea or hot chocolate hot for hours on end in this mug. Perfect for at home, the office, while camping and more.
KEEP DRINKS COLD, TOO: This mug is also great for keeping cold drinks icy cold, whether you're enjoying iced tea, soda, or adult beverages.
DURABLY CONSTRUCTED PREMIUM MUG: The double-wall stainless steel design keeps your drinks hot or cold without sweating or burning your hands.

A LID THAT WON’T LEAK!: The screw-on lid is leak-proof, so you don't have to worry about your beverage leaking. The flip-top lid securely fastens closed while not drinking and easily opens with one hand when you're ready to drink.
EASY TO CLEAN: The lid of the mug is dishwasher safe for easy cleaning. The wide opening of the mug makes it easy to clean with most sponges and brushes.

MADE WITHOUT BPA: This mug is made without BPA and is made with high-quality stainless steel so you can healthily enjoy your favorite beverages without flavors transferring from the mug into your drink.
description: This double-wall vacuum sealed insulated mug can keep drinks hot for up to 3 hours or cold for up to 8 hours. The screw-on lid is leak-proof, so you don't have to worry about your beverage leaking. The flip-top lid securely fastens closed while not drinking and easily opens with one hand when you're ready to drink. This mug is made without BPA and is made with high-quality stainless steel so you can healthily enjoy your favorite beverages without flavors transferring from the mug into your drink. Using this reusable mug also cuts down on the use of single-use coffee cups, saving our landfills from unnecessary trash.
